title: Berlin School Registration - Quick Summary
items: **The window is 5 to 16 October 2026, in person.** Ten working days, at the one Grundschule your address is assigned to. It applies to every child born **1 October 2020 to 30 September 2021**, who becomes schulpflichtig on **1 August 2027**. Registration is a legal duty, and you do it there even if you plan a private school or want a different public one.

**Your address, not your choice, names the school.** Berlin is divided into **394 Einschulungsbereiche** holding **413 public primary schools**. Measured from the Senate's own geodata on 17 September 2026: **356 areas hold exactly one school**, **28 hold two or three**, and **10 hold none at all**. The smallest covers **0.13 km²**, the largest **27.58 km²**.

**A different school is possible but ranked, and capped.** Register at the assigned school first, then submit a written application with reasons. **§ 55a Abs. 2 SchulG** ranks them: sibling and deep personal ties first, then a specific programme, language or all-day model, then care that is significantly easier because of work. **Distance is not a legal ground**, and any request only succeeds if that school has room left.

**Bring the Hort form.** Identity papers, the child's birth certificate, and the application for **ergänzende Förderung und Betreuung**, which the Jugendamt must receive **at least three months before the school year**. It is **free for the first three school years**, and for new starters the extra hours are free too: **6:00 to 7:30**, **16:00 to 18:00**, and **6:00 to 18:00 in the holidays**.

**One in eight Berlin first-graders starts a year late.** Of the **35,571 children enrolled in 2025/26, 4,547 (12.8%) came after a Zurückstellung**. That application is due by **26 February 2027** with a Kita statement and a school medical exam, and it can be used only once. Early entry is rare: **720 children, 2.0%**.

**The language test carries a fine.** A child who does not attend a Kita must take Berlin's language assessment, compulsory under **§ 55 SchulG**. If support is needed it is **35 hours a week, seven hours a day**, until 31 July before enrolment. Missing it can be fined **up to 2,500 euros** under § 126.

**Then the dates run for ten months.** The Kinder- und Jugendgesundheitsdienst examines your child, the **Schulamt** (not the school) allocates the place and can move it for organisational reasons, the Jugendamt issues the Hort Bedarfsbescheid, and the Einschulungsfeier is **Saturday 21 August 2027**, with lessons from **Monday 23 August 2027**.
